bagPolicy.summary: Bank of America Stadium follows the NFL Clear Bag Policy, allowing only specific types of clear bags and small clutches. Prohibited items include non-transparent bags, weapons, and other potentially hazardous items.
allowed: Any transparent plastic, vinyl or PVC bag no larger than 12" x 6" x 12"
Purses, bags, clutches, or fanny packs no larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
Containers for items of medical necessity
Seat pads without covers, zippers, clasps, pockets or any other device that would allow concealment of any items
prohibited: All balls, including footballs of any size
All non-transparent bags or items, including backpacks, binocular/camera cases, cinch bags, computer bags, diaper bags, purses larger than 4.5" x 6.5", etc.
Coolers or containers, including cans and bottles
Food and beverages, except two (2) sealed plastic non-flavored water bottles per person
Horns, bells, whistles and other noise makers
Pets, except service animals assisting those with disabilities
Seat cushions with covers, zippers, clasps, pockets or any other device that would allow concealment of any item
Weapons of any kind and size, including guns, knives, scissors and those carried with a permit
Other items that in the judgment of stadium management pose a safety hazard or diminish the enjoyment of an event by other patrons
bagPolicy.note: Containers for items of medical necessity are allowed but require approval.

parking.note: There are more than 30,000 parking spaces within a 10-15 minute walk of the stadium. Convenient and affordable parking can be reserved in advance through SpotHero.

rideshare.note: The City of Charlotte advises fans to pick up and drop off using their preferred rideshare app at the corner of Third and Church Streets, next to Romare Bearden Park.

concessions.note: The stadium offers alcoholic beverages with a strict ID policy and limits on purchases. Alcohol sales end at the third quarter. No specific food options are detailed.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Bank of America Stadium's stadium recognizes the needs of persons with disabilities, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990 and continues to make every effort to comply with both ADA and state accessibility mandates.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Bank of America Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For FC match days, the Ticket Office will open 4 hours prior to kickoff time. The Carolina Panthers / Charlotte FC Ticket Office is located between the South Gate and BCBS NC East Gate of Bank of America Stadium and due to construction is temporarily only open on event days.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Bank of America Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
